$comment: Selection card schema — methodology.md section 8. Every selection, taken or rejected, uses this exact shape. A rejected selection uses the same fields (section 9) so the rejected-selection audit is directly comparable to the ledger.

selection.description: e.g. home_win, draw, away_win, btts_yes, btts_no; omitted if decision is declined with no candidate selection

estimate_method.description: the stated model used — base rates, xG-derived, etc. Must be fitted before the fixture, per methodology section 7.

required_strike_rate.description: equals fair_probability; restated for readability on the card

decision_reason.description: required when declined; e.g. edge_below_threshold, insufficient_evidence, team_news_unconfirmed

price_obtained_by_owner.description: filled in only after the owner actually places the bet; the price he got, not the price shown at selection time

clv.description: implied-probability difference between price obtained and closing price; filled in at kickoff
